FN-SMAY55-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 222
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Economic Development
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/26/2023
Senate Bill 222 as reported by the Committee on Fiscal Responsibility and Economic
Development would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) the Department of Finance to
execute and deliver the appropriate deed or deeds conveying land currently owned by the State
of Alabama to the Legislative Council; and (2) the Legislative Council to contract with the
appropriate party, as authorized pursuant to the provisions of this bill, for the construction and
maintenance of a new Alabama State House. This bill will not otherwise directly affect state or
local funding.
